Record Fair Vol. 2 brings vinyl, vintage and DJs to Wandana Brewing Co.

Byron Bay

Record Fair Vol. 2 brings vinyl, vintage and DJs to Wandana Brewing Co.

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:59
Instaread

Record Fair Vol. 2 returns to Wandana Brewing Co in Mullumbimby on Saturday 19 September, with vinyl, vintage clothing, DJs, food, drinks and a new brew launch.

From 12–6pm, the TapRoom and beer garden will turn into a vinyl records oasis, with local sellers setting up stalls for an afternoon of digging through crates and finding something new for the collection.

Record sellers on the day include FloRecords @_florecords, Tropical HiFi @tropical_hifi, Hold Steady Records @holdsteadyrecords and Black Circle Records @blackcirclerecords, with more vinyl to dig through across the day.

Keeping the music going will be Papa Bitcho @papa_bitcho and Sunnyside Up DJ @sunnysideup_dj, spinning records throughout the afternoon.

There will also be a vintage clothing pop-up, craft beer, house-distilled spirits and new cocktails, plus the launch of a new Wandana brew.

Food will be by Common Hearth @commonhearthh, with simple food made using quality local ingredients.

Record Fair Vol. 2
Saturday 19 September
12–6pm
Wandana Brewing Co, Mullumbimby
Free entry
